report.summary: An active compromise was detected on host SRV-DB-07 where the alerting tool reported a suspicious rundll32 command line. Examination of process events shows services.exe spawning cmd.exe running a batch script, which subsequently invoked rundll32.exe to perform an LSASS memory dump via comsvcs.dll to C:\Windows\Temp\l.dmp.

claims.text: The alerting tool (reported by EDR, not verified by us) flagged a suspicious rundll32 command line on database server SRV-DB-07 involving a system DLL export and process ID argument.
Services.exe spawned cmd.exe running a batch script as user CORP\svc-sql on host SRV-DB-07.
Rundll32.exe was executed by cmd.exe to dump LSASS memory using C:\Windows\System32\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump targeting PID 624 and writing to C:\Windows\Temp\l.dmp.

recommended_next_steps: Isolate host SRV-DB-07 immediately to prevent further credential access and lateral movement.
Collect memory dump artifacts from C:\Windows\Temp\l.dmp and surrounding filesystem artifacts for forensic analysis.
Revoke and rotate credentials for user CORP\svc-sql and any service accounts compromised or exposed during the event.
Hunt across the enterprise for similar rundll32 invocations of comsvcs.dll and unauthorized batch script executions in temp directories.
Tune EDR and SIEM detection rules around comsvcs.dll MiniDump usage by non-standard parent processes.

evidence.summary: Reported by EDR on host SRV-DB-07: 'Suspicious rundll32 command line on database server'. Description: 'rundll32 invoked an export of a system DLL with a process ID argument.'
pid 4410 C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe started by C:\Windows\System32\services.exe (pid 1800) as user CORP\svc-sql; command line 'cmd.exe /c C:\\Windows\\Temp\\run.bat'; 0 connections
pid 4420 rundll32.exe: attempt to dump LSASS memory (credential theft); command line 'rundll32.exe C:\\Windows\\System32\\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump 624 C:\\Windows\\Temp\\l.dmp full'

pid 4420 C:\Windows\System32\rundll32.exe started by C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe (pid 4410) as user CORP\svc-sql; command line 'rundll32.exe C:\\Windows\\System32\\comsvcs.dll, MiniDump 624 C:\\Windows\\Temp\\l.dmp full'; 0 connections
ATT&CK v20.1 confirms T1003.001 'LSASS Memory' (tactics: credential-access)
